GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 387.6 (28 Oct 48) REP
(SCAPIN - 1938)
APO 500
28 October 1948
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Exempt Equipment in Reparations Installations.
1. Effective 1 November 1948, all equipment from nonreparations sources, brought into a reparations installation subsequent to its evaluation during 1948 or later, will be considered exempt from reparations claim; such equipment may be marked "EX" by the owner without prior submission of documentary evidence to the Military Government for its approval, provided the procedure outlined in paragraph 2, below, is followed.
2. After the date mentioned in paragraph one, above, the custodian of the "EX" items will maintain, at all times, a complete file of purchasing, shipping and other documentary data necessary to establish the source from which such items were obtained and the date of their acquisition.
3. Upon request, the plant custodian will make the above mentioned documents available for inspection by any authorized occupation personnel. Failure to establish such proof of ownership upon request, will result in the changing of the status of the items concerned from that of "EX" to available for reparations claim.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
